name: selection
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Generate a finished landscape 16:9 premium Chinese QuickNote feature poster. Match reference image1, the CURRENT campaign art direction exactly: a quiet Mac desktop at evening, deep ink-violet background approximately OKLCH 0.15 0.025 280, soft violet/periwinkle light, a small warm desk-lamp highlight, tactile keyboard keys, luminous pale native macOS windows, grounded product shadows and big crisp PingFang-like Chinese sans-serif headlines. Physical mood quiet, tactile, dependable. Existing brand preservation; no new brand fonts, no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no generic icon-card grids, no saturated sci-fi clutter, no iPhone or iOS claims. This is an illustrative function demo, not an unedited screenshot. Use sparse readable example text and clear visual flow. Don't show any private accounts, API keys or permissions prompts. Do not add unrelated features. Reference image2 is an OLD UI/function diagram, use its functional idea but follow the CURRENT UI described below, not the outdated layout.
Headline left top "选中文字，立即理解". Subtitle "Option + Space · 划词 AI".
Large beautiful two keyboard keys below left: "⌥ Option" and a wider "Space", plus sign between, both completely readable, no Command key.
Visual narrative: left/middle a small neutral document preview with one highlighted selected English sentence "Capture ideas without leaving your flow." A precise blue selection highlight and caret show selecting TEXT, not screenshot OCR. A restrained luminous connector leads to the large native light result window on right. Current result window toolbar exactly "选中内容" then "解释" "分析" "翻译" "拓展" with "翻译" active, blue "导入便签" button and close X. Source text "Capture ideas without leaving your flow." above thin divider, below heading "翻译" and translation "不打断当前工作，随手记下灵感。", with a second "导入便签" action near the result heading as in the reference. No send-confirmation modal. Maintain calm white space, not huge empty result. Footer three uncluttered phrases with arrows "选中文字 → 按下快捷键 → 处理并导入". Smaller feature line "解释 · 分析 · 翻译 · 拓展". Tiny footer "需配置 AI 模型；结果为演示". Show beautiful dark-desk staging, real readable UI hierarchy, large feature-specific title not a chart. Do not duplicate the voice content or bird from image1; it is style reference only.

Headline upper left "框选屏幕，识图取字". Subtitle "Command + Shift · 截图识别".
Large tactile keycaps on left under headline labeled "⌘ Command" and "⇧ Shift" with plus sign between. Small instruction below them exactly "同时按下，松开后框选". There is NO third key, especially no 4 or S.
Visual on left bottom: a small document screenshot with precise crop brackets and a crosshair, containing "产品讨论" then "周三 15:00" then "确认搜索交互" then "整理反馈". A thin violet connector leads to larger CURRENT native light image panel on right.

Beneath, a modest preview of same cropped "产品讨论" document. Then input placeholder "你想了解这张图片的什么？" beside blue "AI 分析". One compact row of 6 small actual quick action buttons "总结要点" "提取原文" "翻译中文" "整理表格" "生成待办" "排查问题", highlight "提取原文". Then section heading "分析结果" with "导入分析" action on its right and faithful extracted text beneath "产品讨论\n周三 15:00\n确认搜索交互\n整理反馈". Keep UI large enough to read; no invented numeric metrics or performance claims. Bottom marketing line "截图与分析结果，都能存入便签". Small footer "需屏幕录制权限与图片模型；结果为演示". Image1 is style only, no voice/pet contents. Image2 is historical capability reference, replace its dashboard and old two-column UI with this current vertical design.
